dct_title_s: A plan of the action at Bunkers Hill on the 17th of June 1775 between His Majesty's troops, under the command of Major General Howe, and the rebel forces
dct_description_sm: by Lieut. Page of the Engineers, who acted as aide de camp to General Howe in that action ; engraved by O. Pelton & W.E. Goldsmith
Coordinates approximate and based on Greenwich meridian
"The ground plan is from an actual survey by Capt. Montrésor."
Includes "References to the plans" and note
dct_subject_sm: Bunker Hill, Battle of, Boston, Mass., 1775
